content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Account Review: Global Healthcare Solutions Division
agenda_items: Action item review from previous meeting
Address competitive landscape and market shifts in mobile health
Brainstorm strategies for improving client retention and satisfaction
Discuss pipeline health and forecast adjustments for upcoming periods
Review QTD performance against targets for key global accounts
key_decisions: Prioritize Q4 focus on expanding mobile telehealth integration for top 3 EMEA accounts
Initiate competitive intelligence deep dive on emerging mobile EHR providers in North America within the next two weeks
Mandate weekly forecast syncs with regional sales leads for the next month to ensure accuracy
Allocate additional resources to accelerate pilot program for new chronic disease management platform in APAC region
attendees: Aisha Khan, Head of Global Sales
David Miller, North America Sales Lead
Dr. Chen Wei, VP of Product Strategy (Mobile Health)
